msg: Good afternoon. I'm an Advanced diver from Canada, on my own, last dive three months ago. I'll be staying at Hotel Rosario de Mar for four nights in June and I'd like to dive on three of those days. What are my options and prices, and do you pick me up at the hotel?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

Good afternoon! Diving on three days during your stay is a great way to explore the Rosario Islands. Since you’re already on the islands, your options include:

- *7-dive package over 3 days:* 2 daytime dives and 1 night dive on day 1, then 2 daytime dives on each of the next two days — *432 USD online* or *480 USD regular*.
- *Three separate 2-dive days:* the 2-day package offers 4 daytime dives for *204 USD online* or *227 USD regular*; for a third day, the 2-dive option is *124 USD online* or *138 USD regular*. You could also choose the 2-day package with a night dive: 3 daytime dives plus 1 night dive for *236 USD online* or *262 USD regular*.

The packages include diving equipment, dive insurance, and a PADI professional. Lunch isn’t included for island-based plans. Your last dive was three months ago, so the usual refresher requirement for divers who haven’t dived in over two years doesn’t apply.

Yes, we coordinate boat pick-up and return from Hotel Rosario de Mar if it has maritime access. The boat may come directly to the hotel, or the team may indicate a nearby dock or meeting point. For the 7-dive package, pick-up is between 9:30 and 9:45 a.m.; the night dive pick-up is around 5:30 p.m.

Would you like to continue with the 7-dive package already in your plan, or compare it with the separate-day options?

🤿 *7-dive package (3 days) - already on the islands*
💰 *432 USD* per person (online rate)
✅ Includes: hotel pick-up (if there is maritime/boat access), dive insurance, diving equipment and a PADI professional accompanying the activity.
📍 Pickup at your island hotel.

👉 *For more information and to book, click here:*
https://book.divingplanet.org/book/package-of-7-dives-already-on-the-island/27?language=en

msg: The separate days sound better: two 2-dive days and one day with a night dive if possible. How do I book that? I'm Canadian, no Colombian ID.
reply:
Yes, that works well: book *Fun Dives – 2 dives* for each of your two daytime-only days, and the *3-dive package* for the day with two daytime dives and one night dive. The 3-dive package is booked separately through its own link.

There is always availability: we operate every day, including public holidays, except December 25 and January 1; if sea conditions are not safe, the trip is rescheduled.

To give you the right link: would you prefer *3-dive package (1 day, 2 daytime + 1 night dive) - already on the islands* or *Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day, already on the islands)*? 🌊

msg: Both, as I said: the Fun Dives for two days and the 3-dive package for the other one.
reply:

💰 *124 USD* per person (online rate)
✅ Includes: hotel pick-up (if there is maritime/boat access), dive insurance, full diving equipment and a PADI professional accompanying the activity.
📍 Pickup at your island hotel.
